name: japan-ec-mcp
display_name: Japan E-Commerce & Secondary Market Search MCP
description: Japanese e-commerce and secondary marketplace search for AI agents. Search Mercari, Yahoo Auctions, Suruga-ya, and get resale/arbitrage guidance for TCG, camera, luxury, and figure categories.
long_description:
Japan E-Commerce & Secondary Market Search MCP です。

AIエージェント（Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT等）から日本国内の中古・auction市場を検索できます。

## 提供ツール

| ツール | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `search_japan_marketplace(keyword, platform, limit)` | メルカリ・ヤフオク・駿河屋の出品中検索URLを返す（生URL経由で最新価格確認可） |
| `get_japan_resale_guidance(category)` | TCG / camera / luxury / figure の転売益見込み・調達先・評価指標を返す |

## 動作要件

- 完全ローカル実行（APIキー不要・ネットワーク不要）
- 依存解決に [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) を使用（`uv run` 経由で起動、Python 3.10以上）
- 関連 Apify Actors: fruitful_quintessence/mercari-japan-search-scraper, yahoo-auctions-japan-scraper, surugaya-japan-hobby-prices

tools.name: search_japan_marketplace
tools.description: Search Japanese secondary marketplace listings (Mercari, Yahoo Auctions, Suruga-ya) and return active live search URLs with pricing context. Use when an AI agent needs current Japanese used-market pricing for a product before purchasing or reselling.

keyword.description: Product name or search term in Japanese or English (e.g. "Pokemon Card 151", "PlayStation 5", "Switch").

tools.name: get_japan_resale_guidance
tools.description: Get arbitrage, sourcing, and resale platform guidance for specific Japanese goods categories. Returns recommended marketplaces, price-reference sources, and condition metrics.
